ideas.title: Investigating Child Exploitation in Skowhegan
ideas.description: This story would investigate the child exploitation case in Skowhegan, including the town manager's alleged involvement and the response of local authorities.
questions: What was the extent of the town manager's involvement?
How did local authorities respond to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of child exploitation in Skowhegan and highlight the need for greater accountability and transparency in local government.
